content: 1. Lalloo A, Glynn JR, Fielding K, van Cutsem G, et al. conducted a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial to evaluate the use of isoniazid combined with antiretroviral therapy for the prevention of tuberculosis. The findings were published in The Lancet in 2014 (Volume 384, Issue 9944, Pages 682–690). 2. Mahomed H, Hawkridge T, Verver S, Abrahams D, Geiter L, Hatherill M, et al. compared the tuberculin skin test (TST) and the QuantiFERON-TB Gold® test in predicting tuberculosis disease in a cohort of adolescents in South Africa. The study was published in PLOS One in 2011 (Volume 6, Issue 3, Article e17984). 3. McCarthy KM, Scott LE, Gous N, Tellie M, Venter WD, Stevens WS, et al. highlighted the high incidence of latent tuberculosis infection among South African healthcare workers, emphasizing the urgent need for action. This study appeared in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2015 (Volume 19, Issue 6, Pages 647–653). 4. Sharma SK, Vashishtha R, Chauhan LS, Sreenivas V, Seth D. compared the diagnostic performance of the TST and interferon-gamma release assays (IGRAs) for latent tuberculosis infection in a high TB-burden setting. The results were published in PLOS One in 2017 (Volume 12, Issue 1, Article e0169539). 5. Spyridis NP, Spyridis PG, Gelesme A, Sypsa V, Valianatou M, Metsou F, et al. evaluated the effectiveness of a 9-month isoniazid regimen versus 3and 4-month regimens of isoniazid plus rifampin for treating latent tuberculosis infection in children. The findings of this 11-year randomized study were published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2007 (Volume 45, Issue 6, Pages 715–722). 6. Galli L, Lancella L, Tersigni C, Venturini E, Chiappini E, Bergamini BM, et al. provided epidemiological and clinical data on pediatric tuberculosis in Italian children, based on the Italian Register of Pediatric Tuberculosis. This study was published in International Journal of Molecular Sciences in 2016 (Volume 17, Issue 6). 7. Van Zyl S, Marais BJ, Hesseling AC, Gie RP, Beyers N, Schaaf HS. investigated adherence to anti-tuberculosis chemoprophylaxis and treatment in children. The study was published in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2006 (Volume 10, Issue 1, Pages 13–18). 8. Martinson NA, Barnes GL, Moulton LH, Msandiwa R, Hausler H, Ram M, et al. explored new regimens for preventing tuberculosis in adults with HIV infection. The findings were published in the New England Journal of Medicine in 2011 (Volume 365, Issue 1, Pages 11–20). 9. Sterling TR, Scott NA, Miro JM, Calvet G, La Rosa A, Infante R, et al. evaluated a 3-month regimen of weekly rifapentine and isoniazid for treating Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection in HIV-coinfected individuals. The study was published in AIDS in 2016 (Volume 30, Issue 10, Pages 1607–1615). 10. Sterling TR, Villarino ME, Borisov AS, Shang N, Gordin F, Bliven-Sizemore E, et al. assessed the efficacy of a 3-month regimen of rifapentine and isoniazid for latent tuberculosis infection. The results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine in 2011 (Volume 365, Issue 23, Pages 2155–2166). 11. Villarino ME, Scott NA, Weis SE, Weiner M, Conde MB, Jones B, et al. conducted a randomized clinical trial to evaluate a 3-month, 12-dose regimen of rifapentine and isoniazid for preventing tuberculosis in children and adolescents. The study was published in JAMA Pediatrics in 2015 (Volume 169, Issue 3, Pages 247–255). 12. Bamrah S, Brostrom R, Dorina F, Setik L, Song R, Kawamura LM, et al. investigated the treatment of latent tuberculosis infection in contacts of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) patients in the Federated States of Micronesia from 2009 to 2012. The findings were published in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2014 (Volume 18, Issue 8, Pages 912–918). 13. Garcia-Prats AJ, Zimri K, Mramba Z, Schaaf HS, Hesseling AC. conducted a contact investigation of children exposed to multidrug-resistant tuberculosis at a home-based daycare center. The study was published in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2014 (Volume 18, Issue 11, Pages 1292–1298). 14. Schaaf HS, Garcia-Prats AJ, Hesseling AC, Seddon JA. reviewed recent developments in managing multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in children. This review was published in Current Opinion in Infectious Diseases in 2014 (Volume 27, Issue 3, Pages 211–219). 15. Trieu L, Proops DC, Ahuja SD. examined the use of moxifloxacin prophylaxis against multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in New York, USA. The findings were published in Emerging Infectious Diseases in 2015 (Volume 21, Issue 3, Pages 500–503).
